input.text: Façade naïve Ñandú ß ø Ł

expected.result: Facade naive Nandu ß ø Ł

source: Unicode rule of removeVietnameseAccents (conformance/README.md): NFD, drop every combining mark (General_Category M, by code point, so marks outside the BMP too) that follows an ASCII letter A-Z/a-z, map đ/Đ to d/D, NFC; expected value worked out by hand from the Unicode Character Database (decompositions, General_Category), not from tingqr
note: Marks after any ASCII letter are dropped, not only Vietnamese ones. ß, ø and Ł have no canonical decomposition, so they stay.
